dnd-combat.name: dnd-combat
dnd-combat.description: Headless D&D 5e encounter authority: the SOLE writer of units + combatTiles + turn state (combatTiles is its own passability copy of the payload tiles, so composed dungeon-gen stays the sole writer of the rendered tiles). ENCOUNTER_START seeds units + tiles from its payload (the dungeon board builds them from dungeon-gen's FLOOR_GENERATED data; an empty tiles payload auto-generates an all-passable grid). Runs initiative via the dice atom (one ROLL per hop), player MOVE/ATTACK/END_TURN intents with strict SRD attack math (nat 20 crit doubles damage dice, nat 1 always misses), and a greedy manhattan melee monster AI processed one monster per internal MONSTER_STEP hop. Death saves are organic: when the hero unit starts a turn at 0 hp, combat rolls the save itself (purpose "deathsave" → DEATH_SAVE), honors HERO_REVIVED (unit back to 1 hp) / HERO_STABLE (unit marked stable, future turns skip the save), passes HERO_DAMAGE through with the crit flag, and bars a 0-hp hero from MOVE/ATTACK. Renders nothing.

dnd-dice.name: dnd-dice
dnd-dice.description: Headless D&D 5e dice authority: the SOLE writer of lastRoll + rollLog. Applies ROLL intents with structured {count,sides,bonus} specs (normal/advantage/disadvantage on a single d20), honors the deterministic rollQueue test hook (queue head per die, math/random fallback when it empties), and emits DICE_ROLLED. Renders nothing.

dnd-dungeon-gen.name: dnd-dungeon-gen
dnd-dungeon-gen.description: Headless D&D 5e dungeon-floor authority: the SOLE writer of tiles, features, monsterSpawns, floor, heroSpawn. GENERATE_FLOOR carves 5-7 non-overlapping rooms joined by L-corridors (connectivity guaranteed by construction, verified by flood-fill with a deterministic single-room fallback), places stairs-down in the last room, heroSpawn in the first, and depth-scaled monster/chest/trap markers. Renders nothing.

dnd-hero.name: dnd-hero
dnd-hero.description: Headless D&D 5e hero-sheet authority: the SOLE writer of the hero sheet (abilities, level, xp, proficiency, hp, maxHp, ac, conditions, deathSaves, status). Applies HERO_DAMAGE/HERO_HEAL/HERO_GAIN_XP/DEATH_SAVE intents with strict SRD math — damage while down/stable counts as death-save failures (1 per hit, 2 on a crit) and a stable hero resumes dying — and emits HERO_DOWN/HERO_DIED/HERO_LEVELED/HERO_REVIVED/HERO_STABLE. Traps are organic: TRAP_SPRUNG rolls a dex save through the dice atom (purpose save:dex:trap, config trapDc), a failure rolls config trapDamage (purpose trap:damage) and routes it through the hero's own HERO_DAMAGE path so the down/stable/death rules apply, and TRAP_SAVE reports the outcome. RESTART re-initializes the sheet from config for a fresh delve. Renders nothing.

dnd-narrator.name: dnd-narrator
dnd-narrator.description: Headless D&D 5e narrator: the SOLE writer of narration (the story feed), unitKinds (unit id → kind mirror), and quest. Listens to the whole delve bus — delve start, floor carved, turns, attacks, slays, death saves, traps, loot, level-ups, defeat — and prepends deterministic narration entries { id, title, status } composed from payloads (status ∈ pending=story | active=hero turn | error=foe/grim | complete=loot — the std timeline pattern's status vocabulary, so a `timeline` node renders the feed with tone-coded dots). ENCOUNTER_START mirrors id → kind into its own field so attack lines can name combatants without cross-trait entity reads. Renders nothing.

dnd-token-art.name: dnd-token-art
dnd-token-art.description: DndTokenArt — SOLE writer of @entity.tokenArt: kind → draw-group items (draw-shape path art authored in the cell-local 0..1 box; resolution-independent, the projector owns tile size). The catalog is config data (concrete colors — canvas paint cannot resolve CSS var()); INIT publishes it to the shared entity so composed boards/galleries paint per unit with items: (object/get @entity.tokenArt kind). dnd-dungeon-board.name: dnd-dungeon-board
dnd-dungeon-board.description: DndDungeonBoard — the playable D&D 5e floor: rebinds the six dnd atoms (dice, hero sheet, combat, dungeon-gen, token art, narrator) onto one shared entity and routes canvas clicks/keys into domain intents. START_DELVE carves a floor; FLOOR_GENERATED builds combat's ENCOUNTER_START payload (hero from config heroStats at heroSpawn, monsters from monsterSpawns through the monsterStats roster) and mirrors features into its own knownFeatures (server runtimes scope entity reads per-trait); click a monster to ATTACK, a reachable tile to MOVE, D/Space/G or the sidebar buttons for DASH/END_TURN/DODGE. Stepping on a chest rolls 2d4+2 healing (purpose loot → HERO_HEAL + CHEST_LOOT), stepping on a trap fires TRAP_SPRUNG (hero sheet rolls the dex save); each feature fires once per floor (openedFeatures). Descending the stairs on a won floor regenerates deeper — unless it was config.finalFloor, which wins the run (result escaped + ESCAPED for the epilogue). The sidebar chronicles the narrator feed (tone → typography color), the last dice roll, the quest hook, and the action buttons.
dnd-dungeon-board.capabilities: dnd dungeon board, tactical grid combat, floor delve, token art board, click to move, click to attack, descend stairs

dnd-dungeon-delver.name: dnd-dungeon-delver
dnd-dungeon-delver.description: DndDungeonDelver — the playable D&D 5e dungeon game: binds the six dnd atoms (dice, hero sheet, combat, dungeon-gen, token art, narrator) with the dnd-dungeon-board / dnd-character-hud molecules' configs verbatim, inside a std ui-game-shell whose addons/controls slots carry the action cluster and the narrator story cluster (same game-rpg-dark theme as the board). Direct molecule-trait rebinding was the intended composition but is unsupported end-to-end: the compiler bars rebinding the board's interaction trait (fixed entity binding, ORB_T_ENTITY_NOT_REBINDABLE) and the JS runtime preprocessor only sees authored traits in an imported orbital, so an organism-level ref to a molecule's rebind trait (Board.traits.BoardDice) does not resolve — both recorded as gaps. BoardHero stays the sole writer of the hero sheet; the std game-hud only reads (the hud molecule's own hero rebind is NOT recomposed — that is the double-hero trap). Boot shows a start menu; START drives START_DELVE; chests/traps fire on the hero's step (loot 2d4+2 healing / dex-save trap damage), Dash (D) and Dodge (G) spend the action for movement or defense, the sidebar chronicles every event through the narrator atom with tone-colored lines; descending floor 3's stairs wins the run (YOU ESCAPED epilogue), hero death shows YOU DIED with Delve Again (RESTART + fresh START_DELVE).
dnd-dungeon-delver.capabilities: dnd dungeon delver, 5e dungeon crawler, tactical combat game, floor delve, start menu, defeat overlay, character hud, narrator story feed, dice chronicle, dash dodge actions, traps and chests, quest and epilogue

std-brick-breaker.name: std-brick-breaker
std-brick-breaker.description: Headless breakout mechanic: the SOLE writer of ball + px + bricks + score + lives + result. A tick advances the ball one cell; walls and the paddle bounce it, bricks shatter on contact (score +1, BURST particle), a ball past the paddle costs a life and re-serves, zero lives loses the run, clearing every brick wins it. Applies clamped PADDLE_SET intents and RESTART. Renders nothing.

std-evade-chase.name: std-evade-chase
std-evade-chase.description: Headless evade-chase mechanic: the SOLE writer of units + heroHp + score + result. Applies EVADE_MOVE intents (steps the hero one cell, clamped to the grid); a 1s tick steps three corner chasers one manhattan-sign cell toward the hero (blocked by the hero cell and each other's cells), adjacency deals 1 damage (hero 3 HP), each survived tick is the score, surviving surviveTicks ticks wins, and dropping to 0 HP loses. Applies RESTART. Renders nothing.

std-gravity-flap.name: std-gravity-flap
std-gravity-flap.description: Headless gravity-flap mechanic: the SOLE writer of birdY + vel + pipes + tickCount + score + result. A tick applies gravity to the bird, scrolls pipes left, spawns a new pipe every 8 ticks, scores each pipe that crosses the bird column, and sets result to lost on floor or pipe collision. Applies FLAP intents (upward impulse) and RESTART. Emits a BURST pickup particle on each score. Renders nothing.

std-lane-hazard.name: std-lane-hazard
std-lane-hazard.description: Headless lane-hazard mechanic: the SOLE writer of hazards + lives + result (plus its own tracked hero cell). A tick slides every hazard one cell along its lane (even lanes drift left, odd lanes drift right, wrapping at the edges); when a moved hazard shares the tracked hero cell, lives drop by one, HERO_HIT is emitted so the glue can send the hero home, and at zero lives the run is lost. Tracks the hero cell from HERO_STEPPED, listens PROGRESS — when no objectives remain the run is won — and RESTART to re-seed. Renders nothing.

std-pong-rally.name: std-pong-rally
std-pong-rally.description: Headless pong-rally mechanic: the SOLE writer of ball + leftY + rightY + leftScore + rightScore + result. A tick advances the ball by its velocity, bounces it off the top/bottom walls and both paddles (emitting a BURST particle on each paddle hit), and awards a point when a paddle misses — first to 5 sets result to left/right and emits GAME_END. When aiEnabled (default) the same tick steers the RIGHT paddle toward the ball for a single-player game vs AI; set aiEnabled false for two-player, where RIGHT_UP/RIGHT_DOWN move the right paddle by hand. Applies PADDLE_MOVE intents (side + dy, clamped to the playfield) and RESTART. Renders nothing.

std-snake-loop.name: std-snake-loop
std-snake-loop.description: Headless snake-loop mechanic: the SOLE writer of body + dir + food + score + result. A tick advances the head in @entity.dir; walls and self-collisions set result to lost; eating food grows the body, awards a point, respawns food on a provably free cell, and emits a BURST pickup particle. Applies TURN intents (180-degree reversals rejected) and RESTART. Renders nothing.

mesh-asset-catalog.name: mesh-asset-catalog
mesh-asset-catalog.description: MeshAssetCatalog — headless publisher that makes any mesh asset organism canvas-ready: INIT emits MESH_ASSET_PUBLISH { kind, states } where states maps anim state name (idle/walk/attack/hit/death/...) to draw-group items of draw-mesh descriptors authored in cell coordinates (z = height), each layer carrying its own keyframe animation — all pure config. Republishes on MESH_ASSET_SYNC so mount order against the 3D board's collector never matters. The 3D twin of SvgAssetCatalog. Renders nothing.

mesh-palette.name: mesh-palette
mesh-palette.description: MeshPalette — the 3D STYLE CONTRACT atom: the library's volumetric art bible as declared data. Owns @entity.meshPalettes (named 5-step color value scales — the same color language as SvgPalette) and @entity.meshStyle (style direction token, per-style lighting rig, PBR material recipes, post-process presets, proportion grid, shape language, motion timing) — every 3D style variable the mesh asset corpus follows, overridable per game via config. The style token names the theme direction (glossy | flat | cartoon | neon | low-poly) every material/mesh molecule branches its recipe on — one flip restyles all material-composed meshes. Seed-only atom (no render trait); compose alongside MeshPrimitiveRender (base geometry) and any material/outline molecules built on top.

mesh-primitives.name: mesh-primitives
mesh-primitives.description: MeshPrimitives — the raw draw-mesh forwarding atom: renders one parametric 3D primitive (box, sphere, capsule, cylinder, cone, torus, plane, circle) as a `draw-mesh` descriptor, every DrawMesh.tsx knob exposed as presentation-tier config. This atom owns geometry + material forwarding only — compose alongside MeshPaletteSeed for the resolved lighting/material story. Renders one mesh per instance.

mesh-material-crystal.name: mesh-material-crystal
mesh-material-crystal.description: MeshMaterialCrystal — the 3D style contract's CRYSTAL recipe as a composable molecule: one draw-group applying the crystal rendering of the active style direction to any config shape. Where the 2D twin branches gradient+sparkle layers, this branches draw-mesh MATERIALS on the SAME geometry+palette: glossy (physical glass — transmission 0.8, ior 1.5, roughness 0.1 — the default, needs the rig's room environment to read as glass), flat (unlit basic fill), cartoon (toon bands + inverted-hull contour outline), neon (dark body driven by an emissive highlight with a default intensity pulse — pair with the neon rig's bloom), low-poly (glossy's transmission PBR with flatShading + the lowSegments tessellation — in 3D low-poly IS a token, standing in for the 2D twin's cutout/noir directions which don't apply to a volumetric mesh). Call sites override geometry + palette steps + style only; the recipes themselves are the molecule. Defaults derive from mesh-palette's style contract (arcane palette, materials.crystal preset).

mesh-material-magic.name: mesh-material-magic
mesh-material-magic.description: MeshMaterialMagic — the 3D style contract's MAGIC recipe as a composable molecule: one draw-group applying the magical-energy rendering of the active style direction to any config shape. Where the 2D twin branches gradient+halo layers, this branches draw-mesh MATERIALS on the SAME geometry+palette: glossy (emissive-driven standard PBR core with a gentle idle bob+pulse — the default), flat (unlit fill, static — no default pulse), cartoon (toon bands + inverted-hull contour outline, static), neon (dark body driven by a brighter emissive highlight with the default bob+pulse — pair with the neon rig's bloom), low-poly (glossy's emissive PBR with flatShading + the lowSegments tessellation, still bobbing+pulsing — in 3D low-poly IS a token, standing in for the 2D twin's cutout/noir directions which don't apply to a volumetric mesh). Call sites override geometry + palette steps + style only; the recipes themselves are the molecule. Defaults derive from mesh-palette's style contract (arcane palette, materials.magic preset, motion.idleMs bob+pulse).

mesh-material-metal.name: mesh-material-metal
mesh-material-metal.description: MeshMaterialMetal — the 3D style contract's METAL recipe as a composable molecule: one draw-group applying the metal rendering of the active style direction to any config shape. Where the 2D twin branches gradient layers, this branches draw-mesh MATERIALS on the SAME geometry+palette: glossy (standard PBR, metalness 0.9 roughness 0.25 — chrome under the room environment, the default), flat (unlit basic fill), cartoon (toon bands + inverted-hull contour outline), neon (dark body driven by an emissive highlight with a default intensity pulse — pair with the neon rig's bloom), low-poly (glossy's PBR with flatShading + the lowSegments tessellation — in 3D low-poly IS a token). Call sites override geometry + palette steps + style only; the recipes themselves are the molecule. Defaults derive from mesh-palette's style contract (iron palette, materials.metal preset).

mesh-part-gear.name: mesh-part-gear
mesh-part-gear.description: MeshPartGear — the 3D twin of svg-part-gear: the equipment kit as one draw-group at the character root (config position) — leather belt box with a gold front buckle at hip height, right-thigh holster box, and a back-left belt pouch. All hip-band gear rides the ROOT (not the leg bones), so it stays put while limbs swing. Style flips MATERIALS on the shared geometry (glossy PBR default, flat, cartoon toon+outline, neon emissive, low-poly flat-shaded); metals collapse to dark keepers only in the neon branch where everything glows.

mesh-part-head-banded.name: mesh-part-head-banded
mesh-part-head-banded.description: MeshPartHeadBanded — the 3D twin of svg-part-head-banded on the VRM head bone: a draw-group at the NECK joint (config position) whose items are authored neck-local — skull sphere, olive brow band cylinder, back knot box with two fluttering tail boxes, and two eye slits on the +y face side. In 3D the facing axis vanishes: the same head serves every yaw, so there is no per-facing geometry chain — style flips MATERIALS only (glossy PBR default, flat unlit, cartoon toon+outline, neon emissive, low-poly flat-shaded). The `nod` animation swings the whole head bone; `tailAnimation` flutters the band tails independently (a second animation cannot stack on the bone bob — same rule as the 2D part).

mesh-part-limb.name: mesh-part-limb
mesh-part-limb.description: MeshPartLimb — the 3D two-bone limb (VRM upperArm>lowerArm / upperLeg>lowerLeg): ONE molecule serves all four limbs. The root draw-group sits at the shoulder/hip JOINT (config position) and swings via the `swing` animation; a nested draw-group at the elbow/knee carries the lower segment and swings via `lowerSwing` — children are authored joint-local, so the chain articulates like a skeleton bone chain (rotate the shoulder and the forearm follows). Geometry is parametric config (capsule lengths/radii, joint sphere, hand/foot end), so unlike the 2D svg limb no per-facing re-authoring exists at all — facing is the consumer's yaw. Style flips MATERIALS only on the shared geometry: glossy PBR (default), flat unlit, cartoon toon+outline, neon emissive on a dark base, low-poly flat-shaded at lowSegments. Sign conventions (three right-hand Euler, scene y = world Z): hanging segments swing forward (scene +y) with NEGATIVE rotateX; knee flex is positive, elbow flex negative.

mesh-part-torso-suit.name: mesh-part-torso-suit
mesh-part-torso-suit.description: MeshPartTorsoSuit — the 3D twin of svg-part-torso-suit on the VRM torso bone: a draw-group at the HIPS joint (config position) with hips-local items — pelvis box (suit shadow), chest capsule (suit mid), undershirt collar cylinder (distinct slate step — never a background-shared step, the 2D lesson), diagonal leather harness strap with a gold buckle on the +y chest face. Style flips MATERIALS on the shared geometry (glossy PBR default, flat, cartoon toon+outline, neon emissive, low-poly flat-shaded). The `breathe` animation moves the whole torso bone; forward lean is POSITIVE rotateX (above-pivot mass, opposite sign from hanging limbs).

mesh-part-unit-base.name: mesh-part-unit-base
mesh-part-unit-base.description: MeshPartUnitBase — the 3D unit-body scaffold part: one draw-group rendering the unit stack of the active style direction. Where the 2D twin composes ellipse layers (drop shadow, gradient body, form highlight, specular, contour), this composes draw-mesh PRIMITIVES on the SAME geometry+palette: a ground shadow disc plus a capsule body — glossy (standard PBR body, metalness 0.15 roughness 0.55 — the default), flat (unlit basic fill), cartoon (toon bands + inverted-hull contour outline), neon (no ground shadow — energy silhouettes don't ground — emissive-driven body with a default intensity pulse, pair with the neon rig's bloom), low-poly (glossy's PBR with flatShading + the lowSegments tessellation). Call sites override geometry + palette steps + style only; the recipes themselves are the molecule. Defaults derive from mesh-palette's style contract (crimson palette, proportions grid).

mesh-material-gallery.name: mesh-material-gallery
mesh-material-gallery.description: MeshMaterialGallery — showroom for the mesh-primitives atom's PBR material recipes: a metal sphere, a physical crystal gem, an emissive magic orb (breathing on a slow float loop), a toon-shaded capsule with an inverted-hull outline, and a flat-shaded low-poly rock, all resting on one ground slab inside a room-lit isometric 3D canvas with a bloom pass — proving draw-mesh's material `kind` (standard | physical | toon) plus segments/flatShading/outline knobs render five distinct surface finishes off one shared primitive atom.

mesh-style-flip.name: mesh-style-flip
mesh-style-flip.description: MeshStyleFlip — the one-flip 3D style demonstrator, composed from the material molecules: the gallery row (iron metal sphere, arcane crystal gem, arcane magic orb, crimson unit-base scaffold, gold metal cube) rendered through the mesh style-contract token, with five buttons that flip the token live. Every embed keeps identical geometry+palette config; only style (plus the per-style lighting rig, post stack, and backdrop from mesh-palette's contract) changes — proving 3D art direction is a single token flip across all material-composed meshes (glossy | flat | cartoon | neon | low-poly).

mesh-units-crystal-golem.name: mesh-units-crystal-golem

mesh-units-sentinel-robot.name: mesh-units-sentinel-robot

mesh-units-stealth-operative.name: mesh-units-stealth-operative

Assembly state composes the four mesh part molecules; anim states and the Catalog bake the same skeleton as literal descriptors (parallel authorings, like the svg twin).

svg-asset-catalog.name: svg-asset-catalog
svg-asset-catalog.description: SvgAssetCatalog — headless publisher that makes any svg asset organism canvas-ready: INIT emits SVG_ASSET_PUBLISH { kind, states } where states maps anim state name (idle/walk/attack/hit/death/...) to draw-group items authored in normalized 0..1 cell coordinates, each layer carrying its own keyframe animation — all pure config. Republishes on SVG_ASSET_SYNC so mount order against the board's collector never matters. Renders nothing.

svg-palette.name: svg-palette
svg-palette.description: SvgPalette — the STYLE CONTRACT atom: the library's art bible as declared data. Owns @entity.svgPalettes (named 5-step color value scales) and @entity.svgStyle (style direction token, lighting model, stroke policy, proportion grid, shape language, material recipes, motion timing) — every style variable the svg asset corpus follows, overridable per game via config. The style token names the theme direction (glossy | flat | cartoon | neon | cutout | noir) every material/part molecule branches its recipe on — one flip restyles all material-composed art. PaletteRender additionally composes as a declarative draw-shape swatch inside a Canvas. Compose alongside SvgPrimitiveRender (base geometry), SvgShadingRender (alpha overlays), and SvgSilhouetteRender (contour outlines).

svg-primitives.name: svg-primitives
svg-primitives.description: SvgPrimitives — primitive SVG shapes, drop shadows, and geometric transformations atom for high-fidelity SVG assets. Owns @entity.svgPrimitives: maps shape primitive name (circle, ellipse, rect, roundedRect, diamond, shield, banner, dropShadowDisc, dropShadowRect) to reusable draw-shape descriptors authored in normalized 0..1 cell coordinates. Provides default stroke, fill, drop-shadow opacity/transparency, and transform defaults. Renders nothing.

svg-shading.name: svg-shading
svg-shading.description: SvgShading — alpha-transparency overlay layers for 3D form depth. ShadingRender composes as a declarative draw-shape inside a Canvas, painting soft shadows, specular highlights, bevels, and glows with translucent fills. Compose alongside SvgPrimitiveRender (base geometry) and SvgSilhouetteRender (contour outlines).

svg-silhouette.name: svg-silhouette
svg-silhouette.description: SvgSilhouette — bold contour strokes for instant visual recognition at any scale. SilhouetteRender composes as a declarative draw-shape inside a Canvas, painting thick outline paths and rect borders that guarantee readability. Compose alongside SvgPrimitiveRender (base geometry) and SvgShadingRender (alpha overlays).

svg-material-crystal.name: svg-material-crystal

The style token picks the recipe branch on the SAME geometry+palette: glossy (off-center rimLight→highlight→midBase→ambientShadow radial gradient, glow shadow, pulsing white sparkle, ambientShadow contour — the default), flat (midBase fill + one rimLight shine dot), cartoon (highlight flat fill, big shine, thick 6px contour), neon (no fill — halo + bright glow strokes with the pulsing sparkle kept). Call sites override geometry + palette steps + style only; the recipes themselves are the molecule. Defaults derive from svg-palette's style contract (arcane palette, strokes.outer 3, motion.idleMs pulse).

Call sites override geometry + palette steps + style only; the recipes themselves are the molecule. Defaults derive from svg-palette's style contract (arcane palette, motion.idleMs pulse).

svg-facet-lab.description: SvgFacetLab — the facet-triangulation demonstrator: why low-poly and stained glass are GEOMETRY-level directions, not style-token values. One arcane gem silhouette across four cells: (0) the smooth reference — ONE body path where paint recipes (the style token) do all the work; (1) low-poly — the same silhouette triangulated into six facet paths, one flat palette step per facet, lightest facing the top-left light, no strokes; (2) stained glass — the same six facets translucent at 0.8 opacity with fat near-black lead lines on the outline AND every facet divider, backlit light backboard; (3) exploded — the six facet paths pulled apart from the gem center, proving the body is literally separate pieces. The facet cuts are authored per silhouette — a generic molecule cannot derive them from a body path, which is exactly why these two directions regenerate per asset instead of flipping by token.

The preview flips all parts through the six style-contract tokens with one button (glossy | flat | cartoon | neon | cutout | noir — neon/noir drop the ground shadow); the catalog publishes five anim states (idle breathing, walk with counter-swinging limbs, attack katana slash, hit flash, death fall) as canvas-ready draw-group items.

svg-units-shadow-wraith.name: svg-units-shadow-wraith
svg-units-shadow-wraith.description: SvgUnitsShadowWraith — flat-projection floating wraith unit: angular tattered obsidian robe silhouette (zigzag path with three trailing points) rendered with a top-to-bottom linear gradient, white highlight and black core-shadow form-shading overlays, a dark hood void housing two arcane-glow eye slits (radial gradient + soft shadow blur, magic material with no contour), rimLight tatter-fold detail strokes, a small top-left specular, a faint ground drop shadow (it hovers, feet never touch), and a bold obsidian silhouette contour — composed declaratively from SvgPrimitives + SvgShading + SvgSilhouette atoms inside a draw-host canvas.

svg-units-solar-templar.name: svg-units-solar-templar
svg-units-solar-templar.description: SvgUnitsSolarTemplar — iconic dawn templar and holy sun paladin hero unit built from its OWN authored part molecules (winged solar helm head, ornate sun-blazoned plate armor torso, holy solar warhammer gear) plus the generic SvgPartLimb instantiated four times for arms/legs: radiant sun-gold plate armor with ivory surcoat accents, winged golden crest over bronze glowing eyes, holy warhammer. The preview flips all parts through the six style-contract tokens with one button (glossy | flat | cartoon | neon | cutout | noir — neon/noir drop the ground shadow); the catalog publishes five anim states (idle breathing, walk with counter-swinging limbs, attack hammer swing, hit flash, death fall) as canvas-ready draw-group items.

svg-units-stealth-operative.name: svg-units-stealth-operative
svg-units-stealth-operative.description: SvgUnitsStealthOperative — original stealth-operative hero unit built from the four part molecules (banded head, sneaking-suit torso, one limb molecule instantiated four times, waist gear): value-structured layering (silhouette fills, multiply form shadows, screen rim light, dash-detailed harness) over a tapered tactical suit with a fluttering headband. The preview flips all parts through the six style-contract tokens with one button (glossy | flat | cartoon | neon | cutout | noir — neon/noir drop the ground shadow); the catalog publishes six anim states (idle breathing, walk with counter-swinging limbs, crouch sneak pose, attack punch lunge, hit flash, death fall) as canvas-ready draw-group items, nested per facing (front orthographic + right-facing side profile + front-right 3/4 quarter + rear-view back with re-authored geometry: scissor-swing walk, forward punch lunge, backward staggered-crumple death); the Side button previews the side-profile assembly.

svg-units-stone-golem.name: svg-units-stone-golem
svg-units-stone-golem.description: SvgUnitsStoneGolem — flat-projection golem unit: stone linear-gradient torso slab, ONE boulder ellipse reused at two mirrored offsets for the shoulders, a small stone head, a glowing emerald rune on the chest pulsing on opacity + shadow blur, thin crack stroke paths, ground drop shadow, and a bold dark contour — composed declaratively from SvgPrimitives + SvgShading + SvgSilhouette atoms inside a draw-host canvas.
